name: Tetra SafeStart Plus
description: Live nitrifying bacteria for instant biofilter seeding, allowing fish to be added sooner. Seeds the biofilter — no water-chemistry `contributes`.
notes: Single dose at setup; avoid dosing dechlorinator-heavy water within 24 h as it can stress the live culture. Roughly 5 ml per 38 L (per 10 US gal).
